location_exception_reason: Modular toilets are manufactured commodities with standardised specifications (FRP, GI steel, UPVC construction; WC type; seater count). Origin location does not alter product function or buyer decision — a single-seater FRP cabin from Jodhpur performs identically to one from Ghaziabad. Location is a seller attribute, not a product attribute.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Dealer') in modular toilet titles are redundant — IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'FRP Modular Toilet Cabin Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product title. The business relationship does not change what is being sold.
